Based on the provided images, here are the precise answers to your questions:

**(1) Image 1 (Mobile 390px):**
*   **Header Bar:** No elements are overlapping, cut off, or overflowing the header bar. All icons and text ("قسم توريات", "ImIn", etc.) are fully contained within the white container. The text is readable.
*   **Stat Cards:** The 3 stat cards are readable and non-overlapping. However, due to the narrow width, the text inside the cards is truncated (e.g., "س..." instead of the full word for Students, "ب..." for Courses). This is a layout adaptation (truncation), not an overlap or overflow defect.

**(2) Image 2 (Tablet 768px):**
*   **Header Bar:** No elements are overlapping, cut off, or overflowing. The wider space allows "نوته التعليمية" to be fully visible alongside "قسم توريات". The text is perfectly readable.
*   **Stat Cards:** The 3 stat cards are fully readable and non-overlapping. Unlike the mobile view, the full text labels are visible (e.g., "طلاب دون ردود فعل", "لا نشاط مهام").

**Summary of Defects:**
There are **no actual defects** regarding overlaps, cutoffs, or overflows in either image. The only difference is that the mobile view (Image 1) uses text truncation (ellipsis) within the stat cards to fit the smaller screen, while the tablet view (Image 2) displays the complete text strings.
